brief: Inspect Harrowgate Park 230/34kV (SUB-SGW-470) for outstanding work and complete any items in categories 1 to 3 before the event begins wherever crew capacity allows, as required by SOP-016. Because the unit is 33 years old with a history of high loading, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 if pre-event attention is not possible, in accordance with MG-023. Record every de-rating applied along with its reason, value, and period as specified in MG-021.
